content.title: Discounts with Upside | Driving & Delivering | Uber Help
content.text: Upside is a discount platform that Uber has partnered with to help you save money. If you’re a driver, you can get cash back on purchases like: Gas Groceries Food at restaurants Items from convenience stores Simply use the pit stop feature in the Uber Driver app to find participating locations and start saving. Sign up for Upside Open your Uber Driver app. Tap “Cash-back on fuel.” Follow the on-screen instructions to sign up. Using Upside Sign into your Uber Driver app and go online. Tap the coffee mug icon to see pit stop deals on the map. Choose a pit stop to get more details. Tap “Navigate” to get directions to the location. Drive to the pit stop. Select “Claim deal at this stop” to open Upside and sign up. Use the card linked to your Upside account to pay. After your break, tap “Resume” to go back online. You’ll get cash back in your Wallet after 10-14 business days once Upside confirms your transaction. Limitations of Upside offers Each deal is valid for up to 50 gallons. You can claim up to 5 fuel offers daily. You’re limited to 2 offers per gas station each day. Additional savings with Uber Pro Card 2%-6% cash back on fuel, based on your Uber Pro tier. 4%-12% cash back on electric vehicle charging. Use Mastercard Easy Savings for an extra 1% cash back at selected places. Terms of Upside discounts Uber isn’t responsible for external company products, services, or terms. Banking services provided by Evolve Bank & Trust, Member FDIC. Uber Pro Card is a Mastercard debit card issued by Evolve Bank & Trust. Cash-back benefits vary by your Uber Pro status. Mastercard Easy Savings might not be available everywhere. Remember, always read the terms and conditions carefully for any financial services or offers you participate in.
